MAIN checks canonical cache/hooks before activation. No other writer owns it.

blueprint, statement-integrity and proof-dependency policy. Current owner's

dispatch.sh, review.sh, autofix, lanes, descendants, other keys or primary

explanation in its proper existing context if actually needed, without
duplicating or broadening the chapter. Do not merely hide a real dependency.

Read source lem:qld-unitary in
references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1669-1685,

quantifier order and supplied/produced witness distinctions.

Make one normal local fix(review) commit. No push, merge/rebase/fetch,

Write /tmp/pr584-f1-proof-prose-fix-20260918-receipt.md with start/new head,

and receipt. Stop at the deadline with a precise checkpoint if unfinished.
One assignment/thread, no deadline or proof-budget reset.

pr.title: feat(QPBT/Extraction): compose source unitary existence
pr.body:
### Motivation
- Address issue #123's missing source-facing composition for `lem:qld-unitary` (paper chapter 14, lines 1666-1860; blueprint chapter 16) using the proved global constructor and completed conditional extraction theorem.

### Description
- Add `exists_extractionWitness` with the global witness constructed inside the proof, constants chosen universally, full projective/zero-error domain, heterogeneous register carriers, concrete swap unitaries, and the nested extraction scale.
- Link the source blueprint node and update only directly related conditional-node/status prose and the extraction paper-gap register. No isometry transfer or final soundness claim; other #123 targets and older attempts remain unchanged.

### Testing
- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SourceUnitary.lean`; targeted module and QPBT aggregate builds; fresh `#print axioms` for the new theorem and its two producer dependencies (standard axioms only).
- `texra-blueprint bbl`, `leanblueprint web`, canonical `blueprint_lean_sync.py --update-lean-decls` / `--ci`, paper-gap check, statement/proof-debt checks, `git diff --check`, and ordinary commit hooks. No full build, full CI, local review or publication.

---
Addresses #123

<!-- mipstarre-review pr=584 head=22b612efe2f321248092cbe160f723acbb6b3481 -->
# Review - PR 584 @ 22b612efe2f321248092cbe160f723acbb6b3481

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 1a7a9221502d3fdfaf2573d2e63fec5a5a40452a. Six files, 113 insertions and 27 deletions against merge-base dcbcdf0396022e450d08254154ecb1812efbc1e2 on base branch main: one new 56-line Lean module that composes two theorems already proved on main, plus blueprint, paper-gap-note and gap-register prose.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (prose; changes) blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:533 - the proof of lem:qld-unitary gains proof-level `\leanok` (line 532) while its `\uses` is cut to `{lem:qld-4-7, lem:qld-unitary-given-global-pair}`, yet the argument retained inside the same proof environment (lines 534-544) still invokes seven results by `\ref`: lem:qld-construct-the-paulis, lem:qld-win-implications, lem:cancellation, lem:tildew-product-form, fact:triangle-for-simeq, lem:schwartz-zippel-total-degree, lem:v-swap-conjugation. lem:cancellation (blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:686) carries no proof-level `\leanok`, so the cut also removes the only graph edge that exposed an unformalized dependency of the text still standing in this proof. Fix: either restore those seven labels to the proof `\uses`, or delete the retained detailed argument and keep only the composition paragraph at lines 534-540, which is exactly what the sibling composition node lem:qld-construct-the-paulis does at ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:281-291.

## Review

Checked at the published head (the PR worktree HEAD is the same sha).

Source-domain correspondence. The new `exists_extractionWitness` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SourceUnitary.lean:63-81) quantifies `a b C` with `1 < a`, `0 < b`, `b < 1`, `1 <= C` before `P : AdmissibleParams`, `epsilon`, `0 <= epsilon`, `epsilon <= 1` and `S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon`, which is the paper's order: references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1669-1685 fixes the constants of the error function before the strategy, and :1267-1274 fixes a, b in lem:qld-4-7. `deltaQld a b epsilon m d q` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/SoundnessDefs.lean:85-88) is literally the paper's `a(md)^a (eps^b + q^{-b} + 2^{-bmd})`. The conclusion is `exists w : GlobalPairWitness S (deltaQld ...), Nonempty (ExtractionWitness S w ...)`, so the global measurement is produced, not assumed; `ExtractionWitness` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:170-198) carries both two-sided unitarity equations for the concrete swap maps of def:v-swap-unitary, a normalized `aux`, item 1 as the squared state distance, and item 2 as `pauli_close` over `side : PlayerSide` and `W : PauliKind`, i.e. both players and both bases, summed over `PauliRegister P` with the uniform distribution on `Unit` recording that there is no question average. That matches paper items 1 and 2 at :1674-1684. No hypothesis was added beyond `0 <= epsilon <= 1`, which is the paper's domain; the two producers are used unchanged and the proof body is nine lines with no new helper (I grepped main before accepting: no duplicate of either producer).

Nested versus printed error. The Lean scale is `deltaExtract C (deltaConstructPaulis C epsilon (deltaQld a b epsilon m d q) m d q) m d q`, i.e. `C * ((C * (delta_G + sqrt eps + md/q))^{1/4} + md/q)` from MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:136-146. This is exactly the blueprint's printed `delta_qld = C_ext((delta_P^ext)^{1/4} + md/q)` with `delta_P^ext = C_ext B` and `B = delta_G + sqrt eps + md/q` (ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:237, 504-507), with the same single constant at both levels, so blueprint and Lean coincide term by term and the new sentence at :497-500 defines delta_G consistently with lem:qld-4-7. It is not literally the paper's printed `delta_qld = O(delta_S^{1/4} + md/q)` (paper :1672): the fourth root is taken of the enlarged B rather than of delta_S, and the two agree only after absorbing sqrt eps and md/q into delta_S, which needs `b <= 1/2` for the sqrt eps term (md/q is absorbed for every admissible tuple since `a(md)^a q^{-b} >= a md/q`). The paper performs exactly this kind of absorption one lemma earlier (:1664, "absorbing eps into the function delta_S"), and the B-enlargement is pre-existing, introduced with lem:qld-construct-the-paulis on main and displayed in the blueprint statement rather than hidden. Nothing in this PR claims the two coincide: the gap register row and docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex:209-221 both say "nested extraction scale". So I raise no finding, but the absorption itself is neither formalized nor written down anywhere I could find, and the main session may want a one-paragraph note recording that the certified scale equals the paper's printed one only under that constant normalization.

Retained markers and status. Every `**Unfaithful:**` and `**Scope restriction:**` marker the diff touches is kept: MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:211, :244 and :152 only gain a cross-reference to the new theorem. No marker is removed or weakened, and the conditional theorems keep the supplied-witness deviation on record. The one source node that gains `\leanok` is lem:qld-unitary, whose blueprint statement now displays the full scale it is certified at, as the faithful-formalization policy requires for a `\leanok` on a source-labelled entry (AGENTS.md, "A scope-restricted theorem may be marked `\leanok` only against a blueprint statement that explicitly states the restriction"). The new theorem needs no marker of its own: the deviation its dependency records is the supplied `GlobalPairWitness`, and that is precisely what this composition discharges, by the elimination route the dependency's own marker names. The gap-note and gap-register edits are accurate about what remains open: the isometry range-projection transfer, the other issue 123 targets, and the fact that the direct-carrier proof of the global constructor does not discharge the seed-indexed correspondence of qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex.

Proof integrity. `#print axioms` from a probe file outside every worktree, elaborated with `lake env lean` from the PR worktree, gives `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` for `exists_extractionWitness` and for both producers. No sorry, admit, axiom or native_decide in the diff. Exact-head CI is green: local-ci/summary "all gating steps passed (322s)", including build, proof-debt, proof-evasion, blueprint-sync, blueprint-render, paper-gaps and file-length. Commit subjects follow the convention and contain no closing reference. Docstring locators spot-checked against the mirror: :1267-1274 is lem:qld-4-7, :1669-1685 is lem:qld-unitary, :1864-1875 is the isometry passage the note describes. The new module follows the local module-docstring practice of its siblings.

Prior reviews: none exists on this PR, so no earlier finding needed resolution.

Not checked: I did not run a full build or re-verify the internals of the two producer proofs, which are unchanged on main; I did not evaluate the blueprint dependency graph rendering itself, only the `\uses` text; and I did not assess the other issue 123 targets or final soundness, which stay open by design.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=APPROVED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
